description: Unified private beta issue intake register. Every issue supports issue ID, date, tester, device, version, description, expected behavior, actual behavior, subsystem owner, status, regression verification, resolved version, and tester verification.

regressionVerified.notes: Dashboard workflow coverage added for Anthony first launch, PWA reopen, and refresh preserving Rep-only UI.

issues.description: Active Pool corrections needed clean deploy/runtime alignment after Data residential-house quarantine.
issues.expectedBehavior: Dashboard runtime and deploy fallback use the corrected Active Pool and exclude quarantined residential-house barber-shop records.
issues.actualBehavior: Data quarantine and Dashboard deploy/runtime assets required synchronization before Saturday verification.

regressionVerified.notes: Active Pool Asset Synchronization v1 synchronized deploy Active Pool to 297 records / 594 route records and sanitized full fallback to remove the three quarantined residential place IDs.
